# Matt Pocock's skills (vendored)

Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills (MIT, see LICENSE)
Commit: abeeaf95660ba9e8b7c753eb38f441ca707a8823
Plugin version: 1.3.2

These are the 27 skills the official `mattpocock-skills` plugin ships
(engineering + productivity), flattened into `claude/skills/` so `scripts/setup.sh`
copies them to `~/.claude/skills` with the rest. The frozen `misc/` and
unfinished `in-progress/` skills are left out.

Don't also install the Claude Code plugin, or you'll get every skill twice.

After installing, run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills` once per repo you use them in.

To update: `scripts/update-mattpocock-skills.sh` (then review the diff and commit).

Skills:
- ask-matt
- diagnosing-bugs
- grill-with-docs
- triage
- improve-codebase-architecture
- setup-matt-pocock-skills
- tdd
- to-spec
